reviews.text: Service & care has been consistent and my dog seems to respond well here.
You guys are the best!  We appreciate all that you do! 🐾🐾🙏🙏🤗

Coco is a special needs kitty. Dr. Chu is always so patient and kind with her. The entire team at Ark is compassionate, caring and professional. We have been seeing Dr. Chu for 28 years. I always feel confident referring friends and family.

I have been bringing my fur babies to Ark Animal Hospital for nearly 30 years and the compassionate care and attention that they pay to each patient is greatly appreciated by both the pets and the owners. Thank you all!

I always feel comfortable with staff and doctors.  There is no pressure to do anything that I can't afford either.  I've known nothing but kindness in this office.  They have always had my pets' best interests.
Me and Stella have been coming to Ark for years and we love it. Thank you for always helping keep Stella healthy and happy!
The staff was great. They loved my new kitten. She got so much love and attention and a new toy.

I've taken both of my cats here for 6 years. While some of the visits were fine, I believe my cat's cancer diagnosis went missed for about a year. We visited 3 times in the last year, first was for hair loss - they mentioned it was likely anxiety and were unbothered bc there was no scab or injury with the excessive grooming. They gave me flea meds, even though she was indoors and there were no other signs of fleas. Second was for the hair loss and weight loss, they mentioned that the weight loss was good because she was slightly overweight before, and again, hair loss wasn't much of a concern. Third time I took her in for head shakes, which I thought could be an ear infection. No infection found, they thought maybe she's just anxious and we should switch her to a diet food in case of allergies. Blood tests were done 2/3 times. Then my cat suddenly stopped eating, we had to take her to emergency, and they found she was severely anemic and had high calcium, indicating it was likely cancer and it had progressed so far she'd need a blood transfusion, XRay, MRI, and bone marrow sample at that point to attempt to keep her alive. They gave us the news that she'd likely not make it through those. She lived 3 more days then we had to put her down. While I understand there may have been nothing they could have done, I wish they would've investigated further rather than just give us flea meds, diet food, and prozac - especially when we had taken her in so frequently and were persistent that there was no stress in the home, and we had observed changes in her behavior and health. I will no longer be taking my other cat here because I'm afraid my concerns won't be met with thorough investigations.

I really appreciate being able to bring Rexx in early and get him the treatment he needed right away.  I was really concerned at how big his ear was getting.  Dr. Oh was great (she is very caring and knowledgeable) as well as the entire staff.  I appreciate the next day follow up from Dr. Chu and I'm happy to say Rexx's ear is looking really good now.  A big thank you from Rexx & Terry.

All of the staff here are friendly and helpful.  From the time I walk in the door until I leave.  I've been using Ark Animal Hospital for years.  I forget the name of the man who was our first contact there.  I was worried about his retirement.  But, Dr. Chu has surpassed even him with her overall knowledge and unlimited compassion.  My Cali has been through a lot over the last 3 years and Dr. Chu's care has been pivotal in helping me navigate his treatment. He's doing great and I credit her with continued improvement, giving me additional years with my beloved cat.

Always feel like our doctor takes her time and ask a lot of questions in order to give the best care for our dog. Grateful for this office and its services over the past several years. Highly recommend this veterinary practice.

My mom and I have been bringing our pets here for nearly 25 years, and we couldn’t imagine going anywhere else. Dr. Chu and Dr. Oh are truly excellent—both incredibly knowledgeable and kind. They always take the time to explain everything clearly and patiently answer all of our questions.

My cats have a history of being very anxious at the vet, but since I adopted them and started bringing them to Ark, they’ve had positive experiences every single visit. With the help of gabapentin, their anxiety is well managed, and the staff has been wonderful with them. My mom’s dogs—a Maltese and a Great Dane—have also always received excellent care.

Appointments are easy to schedule, the prices are reasonable, and most importantly, we always feel our pets are in good hands. Thank you, Ark, for taking such great care of our furry family members!

I am leaving this review on behalf of my parents. They brought their dog here to have a growth removed. They were quoted $2k - $3k which was insane. I recommended they ask for a second opinion and go to my vet in North County. My vet quoted them $800 for everything. I can't speak for the Ark Animal Hospital's hospitality, but their willingness to upsell by so much is awful. I recommend you also get a second opinion if you go here and are told a questionable amount of money.

Everyone is very sweet and professional. Dr. Dos Santos is brilliant and shares her knowledge of recommendations for your pet while still respecting your decision. Overall, awesome experience - happy to know my pups have a great place to live a happy health!

We have received such warm and confident care with fast turnaround times for booking appointments, and clear strategies for helping us figure out our little bud's allergy issues. We've had great care from both Dr Chu and Dr Oh. There's no judgment and we feel very supported and listened to, and we appreciate that we never feel pressured with hard upsells (at our previous vet, it made it really difficult for us to gauge what was an actual pressing priority). At Ark, the recommended care approaches feel warranted and important, and all staff feel very caring and make our little dude feel so great that he actually gets excited to come to the vet!

ARK Animal Hospital has taken care of all our pups since the '90s.
Dr. Chu and Dr. Oh are great and caring.
Wonderful staff that pay extra attention to our baby!
Exceptional front end staff and doctors!!!!!  Been going there for 10 years and have never been disappointed.  Would and have recommended this clinic to others.  Ark Animal Hospital is AWESOME!!!!!

Dr. Ou and Dr. Chu are absolutely amazing!! Excellent doctors who listen well, answer questions thoroughly, and provide high quality care for my pets. Staff is happy,  friendly and very loving and attentive. Everyone there is highly dedicated to providing the best care possible, and will work within your budget. Highly recommend this clinic and these amazing vets!
Dr Chu is Awesome and so is The Staff! Thanks for the wonderful Service!

The staff and vets are fine and my experience has always been good, no complaints about that. However, this is by far the most expensive vet I've been to. They also don't do any surgeries so if you have anything more severe they can't take your pet in which is really annoying. Do your research! There are plenty of other vets around that charge far less! Every time I went I kept feeling like I was getting ripped off and I was! Finally did some digging and found a suitable vet I like that can do everything. Sadly my pet and I will not be back.
The veterinarian(s) and vet tech were very caring, helpful, and informative. I appreciate the straight forward delivery of information and options. Collaborative care at its best! Thank you!

Unfortunately, my experiences with The Ark Animal Hospital have been consistently frustrating. While the doctors are knowledgeable and seem to genuinely care about the animals, the front desk staff is shockingly unprofessional and careless. Every single time I visited, there was some kind of error or issue caused by the reception team—without exception.

I repeatedly felt disrespected during my interactions with the staff and brought these concerns to the attention of management. Instead of addressing the issues or attempting to improve the service, the mistakes only increased. To make matters worse, I later received an email essentially telling me to find another veterinary clinic. They claimed they only want clients who’ve had positive experiences, effectively deciding for me that I was no longer welcome.

This is not how a professional business should handle customer concerns. While the veterinarians themselves were fine, the terrible front desk service ruined the entire experience. I will be taking my pets elsewhere and would not recommend this clinic to others.

Dr. Chu is an amazing veterinarian at Ark Animal! She is always very helpful and great when it comes to bringing my dog to this vet office. The staff are always welcoming and they make our experience better each time we come by. Definitely recommended :)
Great place
Thank you for seeing Dorie on such short notice! Your staff provided excellent care!
Takes awesome care of my animals over many years!!!
Dr. Barre and staff were wonderful. I appreciate their thoroughness and recommendations
Love this veterinary hospital very clean, friendly staff and Dr Chu is the best. Been coming here since Dr. Hetzler had it!

I can't begin to say enough wonderful things about Dr. Chu and the staff at Ark Animal Hospital! They cared for my beloved Golden Retriever, Summer, from age 10 until we had to say goodbye just shy of 16. Throughout those years, Dr. Chu and the Ark staff were the epitome of compassion, professionalism, and expertise. They treated Summer like family, always going above and beyond to ensure she was comfortable, healthy, and happy in her golden years.

Not only is Dr. Chu incredibly skilled, but she also has the kind of presence that instantly puts both pets and their owners at ease. Her dedication, kindness, and thorough care made all the difference in Summer's quality of life.  This caring and compassion flows all the way through the staff and doctors of Ark!

If you're looking for a vet who genuinely cares and will treat your pet with the utmost kindness and expertise, Dr. Chu and the staff at Ark is the one. I'm forever grateful for the love and care they gave Summer over the years.

Dr. Chu and team are thorough, caring and transparent. They also schedule appropriately, and we rarely wait for more than five minutes. I 100% recommend Ark Animal hospital and trust them with my fur baby.
The best doctor I ever met.

Been going to this vet office for 30 years. Previous vet owner to the new owners. Great office, professional,  knowledgeable,  compassionate, smart, and friendly staff. Old an new staff treat everyone with care. They are wonderful with my dogs. I highly recommend this Vet office.

It was my desire to establish a new veterinary relationship for the puppy I am raising for Canine Companions since the vet I have used for years was purchased by a larger business.
So thankful someone recommended Dr Chu and Ark Animal Hospital. From the moment we entered to a sign welcoming my puppy on his first visit, to the vet tech helping me to get my client file ready, to our time with Dr Chu - every bit the well-deserved 5-⭐️ rating!

Great but expensive as hell. They're really good at talking you into things for your animals that really aren't necessary unless they are sick or you are rich. But...they are good vets, so yeah-it's up to you.
They take great care of our dog.
